text: Registry/catalog/packet/native-return/runtime-private storage shall not be ordinary registered objects. Numeric guessing shall not make it accessible. Proofs may remove physical checks/fields privately but shall preserve semantic charges and observable stored/public representations. Alternate thin encodings shall require a different layout/runtime contract.
